:::{#exm-de-morgan}
#### De Morgan's law for a union of die rolls

<!-- no-figure: six die faces listed element by element; the set computation is the content -->

In $S = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
let $A = \set{2, 4, 6}$ and $B = \set{1, 2, 3}$, as in @exm-set-operations,
so $A^c = \set{1, 3, 5}$ and $B^c = \set{4, 5, 6}$.
Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
(A \cup B)^c &= \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 6}^c \\
&= \set{5},
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
A^c \cap B^c &= \set{1, 3, 5} \cap \set{4, 5, 6} \\
&= \set{5},
\end{aligned}
$$

as [De Morgan's law for a union](#thm-de-morgan) says.

:::
